# printmd — Full Documentation for LLMs

> Free online Markdown to PDF converter and editor. Edit, style, and print Markdown instantly in your browser.

## Overview

printmd is a free, open web tool that lets users convert Markdown documents into professionally styled PDFs. It runs entirely in the browser — no files are uploaded to any server, ensuring complete privacy. No account or signup is required.

Website: https://printmd.app
GitHub: https://github.com/kimkyeseung/printmd

## Core Features

### Markdown Editor
- CodeMirror 6-based editor with syntax highlighting
- Real-time split-pane preview (editor + rendered output)
- Responsive layout: editor-only, preview-only, or split view
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+S (save), Ctrl+P (print), Ctrl+, (style panel), F11 (fullscreen)
- Drag & drop to open .md, .markdown, .txt files
- Auto-save to browser localStorage

### PDF Conversion
- One-click PDF export via browser print dialog
- Print-optimized CSS for clean output
- Automatic page breaks
- Page number support in header/footer
- All processing is client-side — files never leave the browser

### Themes
- 5 built-in theme presets:
  1. GitHub — clean developer documentation style
  2. Notion — modern note-taking style
  3. Academic — formal paper/thesis style
  4. Minimal — simple, distraction-free style
  5. Dark — dark background for screen reading
- Custom CSS styling support for full control

### Markdown Syntax Support
- Headings (H1-H6)
- Bold, Italic, Strikethrough
- Ordered and Unordered Lists
- Links and Images
- Code Blocks with syntax highlighting (50+ languages)
- Inline Code
- Blockquotes
- Tables with alignment
- Horizontal Rules
- Task Lists

### Chrome Extension
- Convert GitHub README.md files to PDF directly from GitHub pages
- Apply printmd themes to GitHub READMEs
- One-click conversion without leaving GitHub

### PWA Support
- Install as a Progressive Web App
- Works offline after first visit
- Full functionality without internet connection

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is printmd?
printmd is a free online tool for editing Markdown and converting it to beautifully styled PDFs. It works entirely in your browser with no signup required.

### Is printmd free?
Yes, all features are completely free. No signup, no usage limits.

### Do my files get uploaded to a server?
No. All processing happens client-side in your browser. Your documents never leave your device.

### Can I use printmd offline?
Yes. printmd supports PWA (Progressive Web App), so after your first visit, you can use it without an internet connection.

### Which browsers are supported?
All modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.

### What Markdown features are supported?
Headings, bold/italic/strikethrough, lists, links, images, code blocks with syntax highlighting (50+ languages), tables, blockquotes, horizontal rules, and task lists.

### Can I customize the PDF style?
Yes. Choose from 5 built-in themes or write your own custom CSS for full control over the output.

### Where is my data stored?
All data is stored in your browser's localStorage. Nothing is sent to any server.

## Technology Stack

- Framework: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- UI: React 19, TypeScript
- Editor: CodeMirror 6
- Markdown Renderer: markdown-it
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Deployment: Vercel
- Internationalization: Custom i18n (English, Korean)

## Use Cases

- **Developers**: Convert README files, API docs, and technical specs to PDF
- **Students**: Write assignments in Markdown and export as formatted PDFs
- **Writers/Bloggers**: Draft in Markdown, print or export for review
- **Professionals**: Format meeting notes and reports for clean printing

## Privacy

printmd processes everything client-side. No documents are stored on or transmitted to any server. The service uses Google Analytics for usage statistics and Google AdSense for monetization — no personal data beyond standard analytics is collected.
